synonyms: I Found Amari-chan Next to the Number One Girl I Wanted to Make My Girlfriend
synopsis: Fukusuke, a nice but plain guy, falls in love at first sight with the most beautiful girl in class, Yua. However, the one rumored to be with Yua is Fukusuke's best friend, the basketball ace, Yuusei. He is resigned to unrequited love as a background mob character, until he meets another super cute girl, Usuba Amari, who doesn't stand out because she is overshadowed by Yua. “Um, w-would you be my friend?” Fukusuke and Amari, caught in a similar situation, decide to start practicing "how to act normal" together. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synonyms: Even a Replica Falls in Love
รักฉันเทียมเธอ
synopsis: On days when Sunao is sick, or not feeling like going to school, she is called to take her place. She was born to this world when Sunao wished to have a substitute. No one knows that she exists, but she tries to do her best for Sunao whenever she is called. One day she talks with Sanada, one of her classmates. They become friends, but soon he notices that she is different from the original Sunao...he was the first one who did. She tells him to talk with her only when she has her hair half-up. Sanada does like she told him, and they enjoy their time together. As they become closer, she realizes that she has special feelings toward Sanada. But she doesn't know what will happen to her...if she, a replica, falls in love. (Source: BookWalker)

title: Sugar Sugar Rune
synopsis: Little witch-girls Chocolat and Vanilla are best friends, but only one of them can be Queen of the Magic World. To determine who deserves the title, they must go to the Human World and enter a strange competition. Whoever attracts the most human boys... wins! Here's how it works: When a boy falls for a witch-girl, she utters a few mystic words and the boy's heart will be hers in jewel-like form. It may sound simple, but winning hearts is tricky business. While Chocolat had no problem enticing witch-boys with her forthright personality, human boys seem to be drawn to shy and modest girls like Vanilla. And to make matters worse, Chocolat is finding herself increasingly drawn to the cool and mysterious Pierre-who feels nothing for her! The girls had planned to be best friends forever, but both of them want to be Queen. Will their rivalry ruin their friendship? (Source: Del Rey) Note: Won the Kodansha Manga Award for Children's Manga in 2005.

titleRomaji: Isekai Tabi wa Niwatorisu to Tomo ni

synonyms: Journey to Another World with Chickens!
synopsis: Seven-year-old Otoka remembered his past life memories as a Japanese Salaryman after helping two chicks of a monster resembling a chicken called Niwatorisu in the forest. However, the reality was his family was poor and large. There was no room to raise the chicks entrusted to him by the parent Niwatorisu. Three years passed after overcoming his family's opposition. The chicks grew into splendid female Niwatorisus and began to lay precious eggs. Then, this time, his siblings started targeting those eggs...!? "I'm leaving this house already!" Ten-year-old Otoka carries out a midnight flight together with the Mofumofu strongest Niwatorisus he named Shiro-chan and Kuro-chan. In this way, a free-spirited Isekai journey begins with the cute and these strongest fluffy heroines! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
